pages.text: Your class is the $(item)tome$() you carry and the $(item)weapon$() you hold.$(br2)Put the tome in the spell book slot of your inventory and hold a weapon of the same class. The weapon's own spell works right away. Everything else comes from binding new spells into the tome.

Your first kit comes from the quest $(item)Choose Your Calling$(): tome, starter weapon, one armor piece, and runes or arrows.$(br2)You can learn a second class later by making its tome at a Spell Binding Table. Your main talent tree follows one class; a $(l)Side Class$() adds a little of another.
